units.source_text: “K的事告一段落之后，我接到他姐夫的一封长信。

en.t: After the matter with K had settled down for the time being, I received a long letter from his brother-in-law.

units.source_text: K曾告诉过我，他的养父是这位姐夫的亲戚，所以无论当初介绍他去做养子的时候，还是让他恢复原籍的时候，这位姐夫的意见都起到了很大作用。

en.t: K had once told me that his adoptive father was a relative of this brother-in-law, so his opinion had carried great weight both when K was first introduced as an adopted son and when he was returned to his original family register.

units.source_text: 信里要我告知K后来的情况，并附上一句‘他姐姐很不放心，希望他能尽快回信’。

en.t: The letter asked me to let him know how K had been since then, and added that K's sister was very worried and hoped he would reply as soon as possible.

units.source_text: 比起继承寺院的哥哥来，K更喜欢这位嫁到外人家去的姐姐。

en.t: K was fonder of this sister, who had married into another family, than of the elder brother who had inherited the temple.

units.source_text: 他们虽然是同胞姐弟，但姐姐的岁数比K大得多，

en.t: Although they were born of the same mother, his sister was much older than K,

units.source_text: 所以在K年幼的时候，比起继母来，反倒是这位姐姐更亲如母亲。

en.t: so when K was young, this sister seemed more like a real mother to him than his stepmother did.
I showed the letter to K.

units.source_text: 他没说什么，却告诉我已经收到姐姐寄来的两三封大意相同的信。

en.t: He said nothing, but told me that he had already received two or three letters from his sister saying much the same thing.

units.source_text: K每次回信，都告诉他们不必担心。

en.t: Each time K replied, he told them there was no need to worry.

units.source_text: 这位姐姐运气不好，婆家生活并不富裕，所以无论怎样同情K，在物质上也帮不了弟弟。

en.t: This sister was unlucky, and her husband's family was not well off, so however much she sympathized with K, she could not help her younger brother materially.

units.source_text: 我给K的姐夫写了封大意和K相同的回信。

en.t: I wrote K's brother-in-law a reply that was essentially the same as K's.

units.source_text: 在信中，我信誓旦旦地表示：倘若他有什么困难，我会全力相助的，请尽管放心。

en.t: In the letter, I stated emphatically that if K had any difficulties, I would do everything I could to help him, so they should please set their minds at ease.

units.source_text: 我本来就是这样考虑的。

en.t: That was exactly what I had been thinking all along.

units.source_text: 当然这里面含有让担忧K前途的姐姐放心的好意，同时也不无对蔑视我的K的父母家和养父家的抵触心态。

en.t: Of course, this included my good intention of reassuring the sister who was worried about K's future, but it also contained some resentment toward both K's birth family and his adoptive family, who seemed to me to have treated me with contempt.
